extracted.name: Pan-Fried Broccoli
extracted.description: Make pan-fried broccoli as a last-minute side dish for any meal. The crisp-tender florets are seasoned with just a touch of salt and red pepper flakes.
instruction_lines: Rinse thawed broccoli and pat dry.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute. Add broccoli and sauté until it starts to get crispy, 5 to 7 minutes. Season with salt to serve.
